purpose: Certify charge/hooke/power/timeincr using KnotPlot parameter assignment syntax (`name = value`), then run the 1000-iteration sensitivity stage only for certified-effective families.
base_force_model: ME (mechforce on, elecforce on, bendforce off)

classification.CERTIFIED_EFFECTIVE: No command-rejection marker; common i0 geometry within family; at least two distinct i100 geometries with non-zero aligned RMS.
classification.ACCEPTED_NO_EFFECT_AT_100: No command-rejection marker, but i100 states are indistinguishable at the certification horizon.
classification.REJECTED_BY_KNOTPLOT: KnotPlot reports unknown/obsolete/invalid parameter or command syntax for the swept control.

syntax.note: charge, power and hooke assignment syntax was confirmed on the target KnotPlot installation by the user. timeincr uses the same assignment form here but remains an empirical certification target.

log_policy.startup_preamble: Ignore `nothing to save` / `nothing to output` lines that occur before the first successful `knot loaded` marker.
log_policy.post_load_hard_failures: Treat `nothing to save` / `nothing to output` after `knot loaded` as RUN_FAILED.
log_policy.parameter_rejection: Unknown/invalid parameter messages remain explicit COMMAND_REJECTED.
